info.title: OpenFrame Data Feeds API
info.description: Reusable live slide data. Integrations use scoped application keys for automatic feed/metric ingestion or existing write-only per-feed keys. Session-based registration and key management are admin-only. See docs/data-feeds-api.md. Application ingestion is namespaced by application, assigned site, and source name. Existing unassigned keys retain a separate legacy namespace.

parameters.description: Explicitly disconnect referenced widgets while preserving layouts and settings. For an application, delete its feeds and keys too. Without this option the existing in-use protections apply.

delete.description: Administrator session required. disconnectWidgets=true atomically disconnects affected widgets in drafts and published snapshots, removes this connection and its associated keys, and returns counts. post.description: Numeric tables use nonempty arrays of label/value rows and are inferred as categories fields. A separate source such as production-tables keeps tables independent from same-named number fields. Existing category limits apply: 100 rows, unique labels up to 60 characters, and numeric values within plus or minus one trillion. Included tables replace their arrays; omitted fields retain their data.

SessionCookie.name: openframe_session
SessionCookie.description: Existing authenticated operator session; View/Edit and same-origin policy apply.

ApplicationWriteToken.description: Admin-issued application key; creates/updates only its own named feeds via ingestion. Creator must remain an active admin. No snapshot reads or management access.

fields.description: Unique field keys. Definitions cannot be changed after creation.

siteId.description: Active site required for new manual feeds once any site exists. Updates cannot change an existing assignment.

fields.description: Unique field keys. Application ingestion can append fields; existing key/type pairs remain immutable. Session updates cannot change fields.

sourceKey.description: Application-supplied source name; namespaced by applicationId and assigned site.

siteId.description: Assigned site; null denotes the legacy unassigned namespace.

SnapshotData.description: Complete snapshot: exactly the declared keys, each value matching its feed field type. This general schema cannot encode a feed-specific field definition. Series timestamps and category labels must be unique. Total encoded request <=32768 bytes. Null clears a number; [] clears a chart.

time.description: ISO datetime with Z or explicit offset. Points must have strictly ascending unique timestamps.

expiresInDays.description: Number of days from now, or null for a non-expiring key. Omitted on creation defaults to 90 days.

expiresAt.description: Expiration timestamp, or null when the key never expires. Revocation and creator authorization still apply.

token.description: One-time secret. Only its hash is stored; never included in subsequent reads.

code.description: Stable code on feed-handler errors; standard session-auth middleware may omit it.

expiresAt.description: Expiration timestamp, or null when the key never expires. Revocation and creator authorization still apply.

siteId.description: Assigned site; null denotes the legacy unassigned namespace.

token.description: One-time application key; only its SHA-256 digest is persisted.

IngestData.description: Named metric updates, merged atomically. Unknown names create fields inferred from number/null or nonempty series/category arrays; existing types are immutable. Omitted metrics keep their values. At most 20 fields total per feed. Null clears a number; [] clears an existing chart but cannot define a new chart type. Payload <=32768 bytes.
